context: Prospectively reviewed acquisition, post-hoc timing preparation, one-recording descriptive comparison. ALS timing remains UNVERIFIED.

policy_definition.supported_route: PRAYCG explicit-push-chunk Cyton-Daisy, 125 Hz, package step 2
policy_definition.clock_ambiguity_guard: Reject >= half a 128-sample counter cycle (0.512 s); residual envelope < quarter-cycle (0.256 s). These are counter-ambiguity guards, not timing accuracy claims.
policy_definition.grid: Least-squares sample-index affine fit of native host-receipt timestamps within each independently counter-verified contiguous region; apply only recorded XDF clock offsets.
policy_definition.missing_sample_policy: No insertion, deletion, interpolation of EEG, or gap stitching; anomalous chunks and adjoining boundary are unverified.
policy_definition.selection: All supported evidence-qualified recordings, not a retry selected by failed gates or model outcomes.

record.limitation: Post-hoc sample-index timing approximation supported by exact diagnostic/XDF count alignment and recorded counters. Counters wrap and are not independently recorded in XDF; host receipt times do not establish physical ADC/display timing or prove zero hardware loss. No waveform fitting, ALS correction, target-informed selection, missing-sample filling, or raw timestamp edits.
